description: DOT Parking Tickets is a dataset listed in Montgomery County open data portal (data.montgomerycountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Montgomery County. All parking citations issued by Montgomery County Department of Transportation (MCDOT) enforcement personnel in the Montgomery County Parking Lot Districts and Transportation Management Districts of Bethesda, Montgomery Hills, Silver Spring, Wheaton, North Bethesda, Friendship Heights, Greater Seneca Science Center and the Residential Permit Parking areas. Coverage: Montgomery County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are parking, cars, ticket, fee, citation. The table has 14 columns. Attribution on the portal: Montgomery County, MD. The portal shows 2026-07-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-montgomerycountymd-gov-portal.
